name: app: loads with the start page
app: a new analysis system from the start page
eval: (async()=>{ window.__my3dmaker.actions.updateSettings({ language: 'ko', showWelcome: false }); document.querySelector('[data-start="new-system"][data-value="static"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const s = window.__my3dmaker.state; return s.project.systems.length + ':' + s.project.systems[0].type + ':' + s.tab })()

name: geometry: a box from the ribbon
eval: (async()=>{ const a = window.__my3dmaker.actions; a.setTab('model'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); document.querySelector('[data-command="tpl:box"]').click(); return window.__my3dmaker.state.project.bodies.length })()

name: geometry: a dimension through its stepper
eval: (async()=>{ const st = document.querySelector('.stepper[data-stepper$=".params.width"]'); st.querySelector('[data-step-dir="1"]').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true, button: 0 })); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup')); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); return window.__my3dmaker.state.project.bodies[0].params.width })()

name: mesh: the setup mesh is made
setup: fixed support on the −X face
eval: (()=>{ const a = window.__my3dmaker.actions; const s = window.__my3dmaker.state; a.addCondition('fixed'); const info = s.setupMesh.info; const i = info.faces.findIndex(f => f.n[0] < -0.9); const m = window.__my3dmaker.model; a.facePicked({ face: i, body: info.faces[i].body, sig: m.sigOf(i, info) }); return s.project.systems[0].bcs[0].faces.length })()

name: setup: a force on the +X face
eval: (()=>{ const a = window.__my3dmaker.actions; const s = window.__my3dmaker.state; a.addCondition('force'); const info = s.setupMesh.info; const i = info.faces.findIndex(f => f.n[0] > 0.9); a.facePicked({ face: i, body: info.faces[i].body, sig: window.__my3dmaker.model.sigOf(i, info) }); return s.project.systems[0].bcs[1].faces.length })()

name: solve: static solution
eval: (async()=>{ const r = await window.__my3dmaker.actions.solve(); return r.result.max.displacement > 0 && window.__my3dmaker.state.project.systems[0].status })()

name: panels: one font size in the left and right panels
eval: (()=>{ const sizes = new Set(); for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('#left-panel *, #right-panel *')) { if ([...el.childNodes].some(n => n.nodeType === 3 && n.textContent.trim()) || ['INPUT','SELECT'].includes(el.tagName)) sizes.add(getComputedStyle(el).fontSize + '|' + getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily); } return sizes.size })()

name: units: SI shows pascals
eval: (async()=>{ window.__my3dmaker.actions.updateSettings({ unitSystem: 'si' }); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const t = document.querySelector('#statusbar').textContent; window.__my3dmaker.actions.updateSettings({ unitSystem: 'mm' }); return t.includes('Pa') && !t.includes('MPa') })()

name: edit: undo and redo
eval: (()=>{ const a = window.__my3dmaker.actions; const p = () => window.__my3dmaker.state.project; const n = p().systems[0].bcs.length; a.undo(); const after = p().systems[0].bcs[1].faces.length; a.redo(); return n + ':' + after + ':' + p().systems[0].bcs[1].faces.length })()

name: tabs: engineering data and design exploration
eval: (async()=>{ const a = window.__my3dmaker.actions; a.setTab('data'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const d = Boolean(document.querySelector('.data-tab .data-mat')); a.setTab('study'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); return d && Boolean(document.querySelector('.study-tab')) })()

name: examples: modal example with animation
eval: (async()=>{ const a = window.__my3dmaker.actions; const s = window.__my3dmaker.state; s.dirty = false; await a.openSample('modalBeam'); const r = await a.solve(); a.select({ kind: 'result', id: s.project.systems[0].id + ':mode:0' }); window.__my3dmaker.model.startAnimation(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const on = window.__my3dmaker.model.view.animating; window.__my3dmaker.model.stopAnimation(); return r.modes.length + ':' + on })()

name: examples: thermal example
eval: (async()=>{ const a = window.__my3dmaker.actions; const s = window.__my3dmaker.state; s.dirty = false; await a.openSample('heatSink'); const r = await a.solve(); return r.result.max.temperature > 25 })()

name: language: English
eval: (async()=>{ window.__my3dmaker.actions.updateSettings({ language: 'en' }); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const t = document.querySelector('#menubar').textContent; window.__my3dmaker.actions.updateSettings({ language: 'ko' }); return t.includes('Solve') && t.includes('Help') })()

name: file: save and reopen keeps the model
eval: (async()=>{ const s = window.__my3dmaker.state; const before = JSON.stringify(s.project.bodies); const text = JSON.stringify(s.project, (k, v) => (k === 'result' ? undefined : v)); await window.__my3dmaker.actions.openContent('copy.my3d', text); return JSON.stringify(s.project.bodies) === before && s.project.systems[0].status })()

name: app: no errors in the log
